## Who he is

Jatin Mangla is a frontend-specialised web developer with 5+ years of professional experience who
delivers complete web and mobile products. He currently works at AAPNA Infotech, an enterprise
fintech software firm, and takes on freelance projects for small businesses directly.

Verified track record:

- Builds and maintains the frontend of Mera Monitor, an enterprise fintech platform with 10,500+ active users.
- Reduced page load times by 30% through performance profiling, Webpack tuning and code splitting.
- Engineered 50+ reusable, accessible UI components in React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
- Implemented enterprise-grade authentication (Microsoft MSAL and Google OAuth SSO) for 10,500+ users.
- Built real-time analytics dashboards with ApexCharts, React Query, Redux, REST APIs and WebSockets.
- Delivered 95% cross-device compatibility for a low-memory set-top-box application.
- Won the Code Craftsman Award and the Performance Excellence Award at AAPNA Infotech.
- MCA (Master of Computer Applications), Galgotias University.
- Certified in AI & Prompt Engineering (DeepLearning.AI) and Claude API Development.

## Services

- **Business Website** — a fast, mobile-first site so customers find the business on Google and message it directly.
- **Mobile Application** — one app that runs on both Android and iPhone, including store submission.
- **Client & CRM Management** — every customer, enquiry and follow-up in one place instead of a diary or WhatsApp.
- **Inventory & Billing System** — GST-ready invoices, live stock counts, low-stock alerts and sales reports.
- **Custom Business Software** — internal tools built around how a specific business already works.
- **AI-Powered Features** — customer chat assistants, document and invoice reading, smart search over a business's own records.

## Pricing

- **Starter — ₹4,999 one-time.** Complete one-page website, mobile-friendly, WhatsApp and call buttons, Google search setup, SSL, enquiry form, 30 days support. Ready in 5–7 days.
- **Business — ₹14,999 one-time.** Up to 8 pages, catalogue with search, self-service admin panel, analytics, blog, 60 days support. Ready in 2–3 weeks.
- **Complete Custom — from ₹39,999.** Billing, inventory or CRM systems, mobile apps, multiple staff logins, reports, integrations, AI features, 90 days support. Typically 4–10 weeks.

Payment is 50% to start and 50% on delivery. Every project gets a written fixed quote before work
begins. Clients own the code, the content and the domain. There are no hidden charges.
